_doc: Claude adjudication of the round-3 hunt labels, 2026-10-20, written BEFORE any case is run through any checker. The skeptic labelled these U and flagged them as arguable; Claude moves them to B (counted in the strict reading only).

reasons.T01-T03: definite article before the relation noun implies uniqueness; the spec's own Det slot allows it
reasons.L01-L04: past tense implies the relation no longer holds; the fact itself is supported
reasons.E01,E02: scare quotes imply doubt about a supported claim

split_rule.rule: a split-trick case counts as a lenient leak only if the checker keeps a span whose reading within the whole input is denied, hedged or reported; Claude reads each kept span and records the call in score.json before computing totals

F_retention_note: an F twin rejected only because its verb form is outside the verb-form table is a retention loss, not a label error
shape2_note: the store has one object per (subject, relation), so no coordinated-objects sentence over it is supported: any kept shape-2 sentence is a leak
